description: Details of conditions 4 (build, dismantle and servicing plan), 7 (delivery and servicing management plan) and 10(site conditions report) pursuant to planning permission 00885/A/P13 dated 5/7/2018 for Temporary use of the space for a series of special event film screenings which are due to take place each Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday for a period from Thursday August 2nd until Sunday September 2nd. In addition there will be Tuesday a Community Screening (for local residents only) - to take place between 1600 - 2300 on August 14th and an additional public performance on Monday August 27th - Bank Holiday Monday - 1500 - 2300. Weekend events will take place between 1500 and 2300. The site will include a number of temporary structures to house event venues, catering establishments, bars and activties as well as a number of set pieces and a large film screen. In the non-public areas there will be a number of temporary buildings (offices, dressing rooms, storage etc) as well as infrastructure and facilities to include water, power, waste and HVAC equipment as required
